class: Accessible credential button overlay blocks native submit target
symptom: Saved credentials appeared in the dedicated Sign In form, but no authentication request was dispatched and the guarded native click timed out.
root_cause: Workday exposes an accessible DIV role=button over its native submit button. The login helper preferred the covered native button, while the credential gateway accepted only HTMLButtonElement.form. Account creation already selected the accessible wrapper but routed it away from the gateway because the wrapper had no form property. Its wrapper also delegates a native click, which needs the same single-use credential capability before native submission.
why_tests_missed: Credential fixtures used directly clickable native buttons without an accessible overlay and a companion native form submission.
fix: Prefer the accessible sign-in control. Validate dedicated native credential forms for both native and ARIA button targets, include descendant ARIA actions in mixed-form checks, and authorize only the matching credential companion submit after revalidation. Route account-creation wrappers through the same capability gateway. Permit one validated native companion click from the authorized wrapper; block a second delegated click.
prevention: Model accessible hit targets and native submit controls separately in authentication integration fixtures; verify real form dispatch and guard containment together.
